'''Pa Tho''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Rogues" /> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Pa Tho system/Legends|Pa Tho system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] culture known as the [[Pa Tho (culture)|Pa Tho]], which had vanished<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|14|Pa Tho}}</ref> at some point by [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]].<ref name="Date">According to {{CSWECite|III|14|Pa Tho}}, the [[Pa Tho (culture)|Pa Tho]] vanished at some point after creating the [[Great Subcrustal Tubeway]]. ''[[Tyrant's Test]]'', the events of which are set between [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] and [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]] per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', mentions the Great Subcrustal Tubeway, therefore the Pa Tho must have disappeared at some point by 16 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> Pa Tho was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Nala Hetsime]], who participated in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Rogues" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Pa Tho was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Pa Tho [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square K-14.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
